scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.lint: npm run lint:web && npm run lint:api
scripts.lint:api: uv run --directory services/api ruff check . && uv run --directory services/api ruff format --check .
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:web && npm run typecheck:api
scripts.test: npm run test:web && npm run test:api
scripts.test:rules: firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project cashsathi-local "npx vitest run infra/firebase/firestore.rules.test.ts"
